text:
maya: Quick heads-up — ranker-v2-quant went into shadowbench and offline eval shows ndcg@10 drop ~-2.8% vs baseline. Not a huge regress but above our onboarding tolerance. Repro steps below and an initial hypothesis about missing doc metadata causing feature skew.

sam: Which holdout + exact command? paste the eval call pls.

maya: Here it is: `./eval_harness --model ranker-v2-quant --dataset holdout/core --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --seed 42 --preproc-config=prod-v2`

lee: Can you dump a couple of the failing examples (query + top candidates) so we can inspect?

maya: Pasting two anonymized lines from the holdout after preprocessing:
`{"query":"how to reset pwd","doc_id":"d123","text":"Reset password steps...","metadata":{}}`
`{"query":"install ssl cert","doc_id":"d987","text":"Install cert...","metadata":{"source":"kb","author":"ops"}}`
Notice the first one lost its metadata while the baseline had source+author for most docs.

anya: If metadata keys like source/author are used to generate candidate priors or featurize, dropping them will change score distributions. Did the preproc pipeline change between prod-v1 and prod-v2?

maya: Looks like a small change in the JSON flatten step — we accidentally normalized empty strings to {} for metadata. Baseline kept the keys with fallback values.

oscar: That would explain systematic reordering of ties. Our priors feature has heavy weight for `metadata.source==kb`. Losing it pushes KB docs down.

maya: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Add a gating check in the onboarding CI that verifies metadata-key coverage (e.g., fraction of docs with required keys or explicit fallbacks). 2) Require shadowbench eval delta < 1% ndcg OR require metadata coverage >=95%.

sam: Sounds good. For coverage calc we can use a tiny script: `python -c "import json,sys;lines=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin];print(sum(1 for x in lines if 'author' in x.get('metadata',{}))/len(lines))" < preproc_holdout.jsonl`

lee: Also recommend adding automated checks for feature distribution diffs (histograms + JS divergence) for the top 10 meta-derived features. If divergence > 0.1 flag for manual review.

maya: I'll open a PR that updates the onboarding job to run these checks before allowing a canary. Assigning: @sam handle harness integration, @anya verify featurizer not stripping keys, @oscar to add feature-dist checks.

deploy-bot: shadowbench run 1759870001 finished: baseline ndcg@10 0.512 -> ranker-v2-quant 0.498 (-2.7%). details: https://bench.redwood/internal/runs/1759870001

oscar: :thumbsup: good plan. @maya can you add 10 failing example ids to the ticket so we can sanity-check human labels?

maya: yep — created INF-4823 and PR #1234 (wip). attaching example ids and the failing diffs there. TL;DR: metadata-gap + small tokenization canonicalization mismatch look like the root cause. I'll push the preproc patch to restore fallback keys and re-run.

sam: one more ask — also compare tokenization stats: query length distribution and lowercase/strip-punct diffs, sometimes tie-resolution changes amplify tiny feature shifts.

anya: On it, running featurizer smoke now and will post results in the ticket.

maya: Thanks all — will update once the patched preproc + gate land.
